cases.name: original_demo_bug
cases.desc: RDATA decoded from the live ARADDR (the shipped intentional bug)

analyses.summary: rw_overlap (seed 1): assertion rdata_stable failed — rdata/rresp changed while rdata_stable required them to be stable.
analyses.rootCause: rdata and rresp are driven combinationally (always_comb) from the module input araddr (rtl/axil_regs.sv:131). When araddr changes while the handshake is pending, the outputs change too, which rdata_stable forbids.
